correctness.rationale: The Cayley adjacency and forbidden closed neighborhoods are fully defined. Every one of 65,536 subsets is tested via two independent face criteria. Exactly 53,730 nonempty faces enter 26,799 pairwise-disjoint codimension-one Morse matches, leaving one vertex and 131 nine-cells. All 401,088 Hasse arrows are constructed and a 53,730-vertex topological sort proves acyclicity; Forman then gives an integral wedge of 131 nine-spheres since attaching maps are into the sole point. Independent Euler and vertex-cover enumeration cross-check the output; the embedded executable is replayable.

value.rationale: The exact integral homotopy type classifies a natural domination complex of the unique highly symmetric five-regular strongly regular (16,5,0,2) graph, despite 53,730 nonempty faces and mixed facet dimensions. It determines an 8-connectivity level and the strict inequality conn(Dom(C))+2=10<11=tau(C); these meaningful topological data are not implied by ordinary domination parameters, a different neighborhood complex, or a field Betti count.
